verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only documents standard OTP code generation for Microsoft and third-party accounts, including QR scan, manual entry and OATH verification codes. It says nothing about Steam Guard tokens, HOTP counter-based codes, or custom periods and digit lengths. Since this is a fair axis for an authenticator app, the lack of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As a power user, non-standard tokens work too — Steam Guard, HOTP counters, custom periods and digit lengths
